name: block-transition
title: Block Transition
description: Horizontal split-block route transition with row-based stagger and optional content shift blur using GSAP.

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion route fallback with short opacity fades.

props.name: enableContentShift
props.description: Adds content scale/blur during the transition.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration multiplier for the cover and reveal block animations.
